about.title: About Us
about.text: HIC Transformed Life is a Christ-centered church dormitory dedicated to nurturing faith, character, and community. We provide a home where young adults grow spiritually, live intentionally, and are equipped to impact the world.
about.imageAlt: Students sharing time together in the dorm community
about.missionText: To provide a safe, supportive, and spiritually grounded home that encourages holistic growth and a life transformed by Christ.
about.visionText: To be a vibrant community where every resident grows in faith, builds lasting relationships, and lives out their God-given purpose.

values.christCenteredText: We're rooted in faith and focused on helping every resident grow closer to Christ and one another.
values.holisticGrowthText: We support spiritual, academic, emotional, and leadership development in a balanced environment.
values.safeHomeText: A secure, clean, and welcoming place to call home with structure, care, and genuine community.
values.purposeText: We encourage you to discover your purpose and be a light in the church and in the world.

apply.title: How to apply
apply.intro: Share a few details to prepare an inquiry, then follow the steps below.
apply.s1: Prepare your name and school details.
apply.s2: Bring your student ID and a recommendation letter.
apply.s3: Have a short chat with the dorm leader.
apply.s4: Move in and meet your dorm family.
apply.formNote: This form does not send or store your details. It opens an email draft on your device so you can choose the recipient and send it yourself.

living.title: Living here
living.facilitiesIntro: Everything you need to live, study, and grow.
living.rulesIntro: We live together, grow together, and honor God in how we treat each other and our shared home.

conduct: Treat every resident, staff member, and guest with respect and kindness.
Use respectful language; no bullying, harassment, gossip, or discrimination.
Take responsibility for your words and actions.
Keep shared spaces clean and leave them better than you found them.
Communicate openly and humbly when conflict arises.
quiet: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM every day.
Please keep noise to a minimum and respect others' rest.
Headphones are encouraged for music, calls, or media during quiet hours.
Be considerate in hallways, rooms, and common areas.
visitors: All visitors must sign in at the front desk and be accompanied by a resident.
Visitors are welcome during daytime hours, but must respect community guidelines.
Visitors meet in the common area.
Please be mindful of others' privacy and personal space.
kitchen: Clean up after yourself—dishes, food, and spills.
Label and store your food; do not use items that are not yours.
Use shared appliances and supplies respectfully and return them clean.
Report any maintenance issues to staff promptly.
Keep the space tidy for everyone's well-being.
spiritual: We are a community rooted in faith, grace, and transformation.
Attend Chapel and community gatherings as an important part of dorm life.
Respect different backgrounds, beliefs, and stages of faith.
Encourage and build one another up in love.
Pursue personal growth and time with God.

living.goalText: These house rules exist to create a safe, respectful, and life-giving environment where we can grow in character, community, and faith.
living.goalThanks: Thank you for being part of the HIC Transformed Life community.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Here are a few helpful details about dorm life and getting started.
faq.whoAnswer: The dorm welcomes students who want a place to live, study, and grow together with the HIC Transformed Life Church community.
faq.facilitiesAnswer: Facilities include a study room, shared kitchen, prayer room, laundry, Wi-Fi, and a common lounge.
faq.scheduleQuestion: What activities happen during the week?
faq.scheduleAnswer: The current schedule includes daily kitchen cleaning, Tuesday Bible study at 9:00 PM, Saturday church cleaning, and Sunday service at 9:00 AM.
faq.prepareQuestion: What should I prepare to apply?
faq.prepareAnswer: The application information asks students to bring a student ID and a recommendation letter. You can use the inquiry form to prepare a message with your name and school.
faq.contactQuestion: How can I ask a question?
faq.contactAnswer: Use the inquiry form to prepare an email draft. It stays on your device until you choose a recipient and send it from your email app.
